1.

Lord, now we all gather Around Thy precious word of grace; Let it fall upon our heart Like rain on thirsty ground! Keep us all still before Thee, Let nothing lead us astray; Lord, let us not waste The hour of grace Thou hast appointed!

2.

Teach us faithfully to take heed Of the word given to us. Lead us in Thy clear light, Which is now revealed. Open Thou the ear of our heart, That we may hear the Spirit’s voice; For He will faithfully lead us Into all truth in Thy word.
